ValidationRule.description: To verify that the account selected on the POC object matches the same account the opportunity is associated with.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Account__r.Name)), Account__r.Name != Opportunity__r.Account.Name, NOT(ISPICKVAL( POC_Category__c ,"Partner Internal")), DateValue(CreatedDate)>= DATE(2023,08,10), NOT($Permission.DisableValidationRules) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The account associated with the Opportunity and the Account on the POC doesn't match. Please map the account which is associated with the Opportunity.
